items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m here at beautiful Hillsdale College with Fred Radke, and I’m very pleased to meet you.

ctx.x: Fred was interviewed in Hillsdale, Michigan on November 8, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m here at beautiful Hillsdale College with Fred Radke, and I’m very pleased to meet you. And you’ve already enthralled me with some stories so you’re just going to have to tell them all again.
Oh, I don’t know about that.
